metadata.implementation: official fixed-pair CCSA objective/optimizer with shared-backbone RGB+NIR fusion and continuous-AIS residual adaptation
metadata.source_initialization_provenance: ImageNet VGG-16 followed by source_train initialization
metadata.supervision_protocol: all source_train and all target_train labels visible during training
metadata.source_label_usage: source FC initialization, source CE, and pair semantics
metadata.target_label_usage: target CE and pair semantics for every target_train sample
metadata.multimodal_adapter: official ImageNet RGB VGG-16 plus a lightweight NIR residual encoder; continuous AIS residual into the official 128-D embedding
metadata.raw_dn_scaling: fixed /255 with sparse high-DN clipping before ImageNet normalization
metadata.pair_protocol: fixed exhaustive cross-domain table; all positives plus up to 3x unique negatives; two successive direction updates per batch
